dismissed.reason: misreads-source: The description says "As in the guide's own In context example, the cards are Slim", and that an accessibilityLabel names the whole card and the logo is decorative. The In context section only says "Two offers share a row, each card taking half of it. The cards use the package default, Neutral white. Each card's onPress opens its offer". It never mentions Slim, accessibility labels or a decorative logo, so attributing these choices to the guide's example is unsupported.
